name: service1

dependencies.name: service2
dependencies.description: Fetches the current catalog of scored records to compute the average.

description: Public-facing service that asks service2 for its current catalog and returns the average score — the sum of every record's score divided by the record count, discarding any remainder — as a whole number. The same computation runs regardless of which catalog service2 is currently serving; there is no separate path or result per catalog. Logs how many records it handled per request. Requests to a path this service does not serve return a structured 404 body. Does not store or modify any record itself, and documents no response for service2's catalog being empty.
